g.title: j3235372325
g.text: Lizzie. Definitely Lizzie.

g.text: mmmm... They just couldn't help but run Their pretty little mouth and tell you all about Us

g.title: j591187789
g.text: would you prefer that?

g.title: j1160537419
g.text: poor space traveler

g.title: j580595366
g.text: and what if it is?

g.title: j2196464529
g.text: sooooo We thought We should come by and introduce Ourselves... properly

g.title: j3977239899
g.text: one body. two minds

g.title: j360380433
g.text: what don't you understand?

g.title: j3019933664
g.text: Hello, Lizzie.

g.title: j898598696
g.text: certainly of all people, that wouldn't be so straange to You...

g.title: j1652440845
g.text: Hellooooo...

g.title: j1322545858
g.text: Nope. Talk to me when Flare is back. I'm out. [End.]

g.title: j3661686218
g.text: We have a question for You

g.title: j2000370067
g.text: what... are You afraid of little old Us...? ;)

g.title: j3673279656
g.text: A Very Important One

g.title: j3271057574

g.title: j234861393
g.text: Do You...

j4185807172
g.text: Love Us...?

g.title: j1748075112
g.text: No. The Infestation is a necessary evil, nothing more.

g.title: j3763097526
g.text: Yes. The Infestation is a part of all my Warframes. So... I suppose I do.

g.title: j260181205
g.text: Maybe. The Infestation is a part of my life, but I don't know if I can trust it.

g.title: j651036090
g.text: Is That So...?

g.title: j3189725313
g.text: Good... That makes Us happy to hear, Sugar

g.title: j829862537
g.text: SILLY DEMON. Confusing TRUST with LOVE.

g.title: j250497491
g.text: Invoke /Lotus/Scripts/1999/HexSyndicateDialog.lua:SetupJumpScare(breakUpFadeTimer=1, breakUpEasterEggChance=0.02, questRankLimit=3)

g.title: j3328232735
g.text: We Love You. We want You to know that. We have watched You and Loved You through the Centuries...

g.title: j510990195
g.text: but We will accept that... for now. We will ask again, someday, Sugar

g.title: j1788160204
g.text: Boolean FlareJumpScare is now true.

g.title: j492946432
g.text: How so?

g.title: j3293971421
g.text: Really? The hordes of techrot and Infested that are always trying to kill me say otherwise.

g.title: j3960856350
g.text: We breathe for You. Bleed for You. Feed for You. Is this demon pleased?

g.title: j4195423318
g.text: And do Your white blood cells not attack You when You are Sick?!

g.title: j2788236508
g.text: Just when I thought this couldn't get any weirder...

g.title: j2237316469
g.text: You're the Helminth?!

g.title: j2776593249
g.text: We are Many. We are the Forever. We are Throughout Time. We are the All. Forgive us the Few we Do Not See.

g.title: j2839432660
g.text: Mmmmhehehehe... poor Demon... made of stolen fingers and Infested Toys...

g.title: j3972011250
g.text: We Are All And We Are One

g.title: j390020751
g.text: once Alone, Alone no longer

g.title: j1376934812
g.text: but fear not

g.title: j1368058901
g.text: We are so Happy for You

g.title: j3515186573
g.text: We. Love. You. And Always Have

g.title: j614472366
g.text: so this is why We are asking You... no... BEGGING YOU....

g.title: j233974741
g.text: this one is OURS

g.title: j900031229
g.text: Let Us Have Them...

g.title: j4183240869
g.text: pretty pretty please....?

g.title: j3700000198
g.text: What do you mean "have" them? Like the madness takes the other Warframes?

g.title: j2948412373
g.text: Not without them being on board.

g.title: j1677408995
g.text: I... I can't. I'm sorry. I can't let you "have" Flare.

g.title: j3036778523
g.text: Noooo!! Of COURSE not!!! We Cannot do such a thing to Them. Not with the way the Doktor Has Done It

g.title: j3141892072
g.text: Then you must talk to Them. Convince Them that we mean Them no harm!!

g.title: j770478285
g.text: NO. THEY ARE OURS. YOU CANNOT LET THEM SILENCE US!!!

g.title: j1558117168
g.text: But neither do We wish to Leave Them!!!

g.title: j3890825456
g.text: If you plan to make them go mad like you do other Warframes...

g.title: j2089097214
g.text: I don't know. Eating their soul seems pretty harmful.

g.title: j4255654858
g.text: Do not Let Them Silence Us!!

g.title: j691912512
g.text: WE DO NOT MAKE THEM EMPTY

g.title: j3184367110
g.text: WE NEVER SAID ANY SUCH THING

g.title: j2354982412
g.text: TALK TO THEM FOR US. WE LOVE YOU. PLEASE. YOU MUST DO THIS FOR US

g.title: j121076174
g.text: THAT. IS. NOT. OUR. FAULT.

g.title: j2275461877
g.text: Fine...

g.title: j2442039711
g.text: I... don't know... I'll think about it.

g.title: j1594065016
g.text: I'll talk to Flare...

g.title: j1815628304
g.text: Boolean FlareLizzieNoFault is now true.
